$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the multi-target build. Edit this, then run `npm run build` to regenerate .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, .agents/plugins/marketplace.json, plugins/*, and manifest.json. CI (`npm test`) fails if the generated files drift from this config.

marketplace.name: lightcone-research
marketplace.description: Agent skills for the Lightcone Research stack — the ASTRA spec and lightcone-cli project workflows.

plugins.name: astra
plugins.description: Reference for the ASTRA specification (astra.yaml): top-level structure, sub-analyses, inputs/outputs, decisions and options, prior insights and findings, evidence and quote verification, and narrative anchors. Use when reading, writing, validating, or debugging an astra.yaml spec, or when the user asks about ASTRA schema or sub-analysis composition.

plugins.name: lightcone
plugins.description: Work with a Lightcone / ASTRA analysis using the lightcone-cli (lc) toolchain. The `start` skill inspects project state and routes — scoping a new analysis from a research question, or surfacing the next step (run/verify outputs, refine decisions, write narrative, publish) on an existing one — and `feedback` files bug reports. Ships SessionStart/PostToolUse hooks that activate the project venv and validate astra.yaml on save, plus the lc-extractor subagent for literature extraction. Use for any interactive work inside an lc / ASTRA project. The `start` skill bundles the full lc CLI reference (references/cli.md).
